source:
@@U02310@@
First let us celebrate
Carnival and its merriment.
Distractions wont help,
but only keep us from our goal.
We must compose ourselves first,
do so in penitence,
and having done so,
earn the lower
by means of the higher.
Who wants the good
must first be good;
who seeks pleasure
must tame his blood;
who insists on wine
must press ripe grapes;
who longs for miracles
must strengthen his faith.

@@U02312@@
Very well!
We'll pass our time in merriment,
and when Ash Wednesday comes
it will be all the more welcome.
So let’s celebrate Carnival all the more wildly.

@@U02313@@
(Trumpets. Exeunt all but 梅菲斯特.)

@@U02315@@
Luck and merit
come as a pair
in the human design;
but little these fools
know of that.
If they held in hand
the Philosopher's Stone,
what good would it do them
without a philosopher?
ATS, DART aye) “QO 2%
translation:
@@U02310@@
首先让我们庆祝一下
狂欢节及其欢乐。
分心是没有帮助的，
但只会让我们远离我们的目标。
我们首先要摆正心态，
这样做是为了忏悔，
这样做之后，
赚取较低的
通过更高的手段。
谁想要美好
首先必须是好的；
谁寻求快乐
必须驯服他的血脉；
谁执意要酒
必须压榨成熟的葡萄；
谁渴望奇迹
必须坚定他的信念。

@@U02312@@
很好！
我们会在欢乐中度过时光
当圣灰星期三到来时
这将更受欢迎。
因此，让我们更加疯狂地庆祝嘉年华吧。

@@U02313@@
（喇叭声。除梅菲斯特外，全部下场。）

@@U02315@@
运气与功德
成对出现
在人性化设计上；
但这些傻瓜很少
知道这一点。
如果他们握在手上
贤者之石，
这对他们有什么好处
没有哲学家？
ATS，DART 是的）“QO 2%
